title: BFP bet set to win Maguindanao del Norte 1st District BARMM seat
summary: Prince Khalid Tomawis is the son of the late former Barira mayor Alexander Tomawis and former Buldon mayor Fatima Ruth Tomawis

blocks.text: Prince Khalid Tomawis is the son of the late former Barira mayor Alexander Tomawis and former Buldon mayor Fatima Ruth Tomawis
COTABATO CITY, Philippines – Bangsamoro Federalist Party (BFP) bet Prince Khalid Tomawis currently tops the Bangsamoro parliamentary electoral race in the 1st District of Maguindanao del Norte.

The province is the bailiwick of the Bangsamoro Federalist Party (BFP), which is led by former acting Maguindanao del Norte governor and Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao interim Chief Minister Abdulraof “Sammy Gambar” Macacua.

Tomawis has received 38,937 votes with 94.51% precincts reporting as of September 14, 10:59 pm. He is the son of the late former Barira mayor Alexander Tomawis and former Buldon mayor Fatima Ruth Tomawis.

The BFP bet’s closest competitor is Abdulkudos Pendatu Balitok, former base commander of the Bangsamoro Islamic Armed Forces of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF). He has obtained 16,816 votes so far, making it impossible to catch up given Tomawis’ lead.
Balitok ran under the banner of the United Bangsamoro Justice Party, the MILF’s political party. – Rappler.com
